title: Shipping Policy
intro: We partner with reliable logistics providers to ensure timely and safe delivery of your KokoFresh orders. By placing an order, you agree to the shipping terms outlined here.

sections.heading: Scope of the Policy
sections.body:
This Shipping Policy applies to all orders placed on the KokoFresh website. Our goal is to ensure a smooth and reliable delivery experience for our customers. By using our platform, you agree to the terms outlined in this policy.

From our kitchen to yours, we ensure every order is handled with care and precision.

sections.heading: Shipping Charges
sections.body:
• Variable Pricing: Shipping fees vary based on the order value and delivery location (₹50 in Karnataka, ₹70 rest of India).
  • Free Shipping Available: Free shipping is automatically applied to all orders of ₹399 and above at checkout.
  • Clear at Checkout: Any applicable shipping charges will be displayed clearly at checkout before payment.

sections.heading: Delivery Issues
sections.body:
We’re here to help if anything goes wrong with your delivery. KokoFresh ensures the smooth delivery of your orders, but the following scenarios may arise.

  • If you receive damaged, incorrect, or incomplete orders, report the issue within 24 hours of delivery.
  • Refunds, replacements, or store credits will be processed as per our Refund Policy.

sections.heading: How We Resolve It
sections.body:
• Quick Processing: We process returns and refunds quickly to get you back on track.
  • Multiple Options: Choose between refunds, replacements, or store credits.
  • Hassle-Free Process: No complicated procedures — just reach out to our support team.

sections.heading: Liability Disclaimer
sections.body:
KokoFresh is not liable for delays, losses, or damages caused by third-party logistics providers or events beyond our control.

We are not responsible for product spoilage due to improper handling or storage after delivery.

sections.heading: Restricted Items
sections.body: Products that do not comply with food safety regulations or legal standards are strictly prohibited on our platform. Sellers found in violation may face penalties or removal from KokoFresh.

sections.heading: Changes to Shipping Policy
sections.body:
KokoFresh reserves the right to modify this Shipping Policy at any time.

Updates will be communicated via email or notifications on the platform. Continued use of our services after changes implies acceptance of the revised terms.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body:
Our support team is here to help. Reach out anytime with your questions or concerns regarding shipping.

  • Email: help@kokofresh.in
  • Phone: +91 78927 76610

faq.question: What are the shipping charges for KokoFresh orders?
faq.answer: Shipping is ₹50 for orders within Karnataka and ₹70 for the rest of India. Orders of ₹399 and above ship free.

faq.question: Does KokoFresh offer free shipping?
faq.answer: Yes. Shipping is free on all orders of ₹399 and above at checkout.

faq.question: What are KokoFresh delivery timelines?
faq.answer: Orders are ground fresh and dispatched within 48 hours, then delivered in 3–5 days depending on your location.

closing.heading: Ready to Order?
closing.body: Browse our collection of authentic, handcrafted spices and get them delivered fresh to your door.
